purpose: Limited revision of Bella Duration sourcing and confirmation of blank Original Bin on MXF fallback.
status: Approved requirements; no runtime implementation or cutover.
authorization: 1. MXF contains duration information, but **Bella’s Duration remains MDB-only**. Use MXF for duration, if we fall back to MXF because PMR/MDB not avail.
2. A reliable MXF source for **Original Bin** is not established. Leave blank if fallback to MXF

agreedBellaRule.duration: Prefer usable own MDB Length/SampleRate and qualified display facts. When the scan falls back to MXF because usable database information is unavailable, use coherent own physical MXF duration and qualified timing/display facts.
agreedBellaRule.readTrigger: This exception does not request an open solely for Duration or verification of usable MDB timing. PMR absence alone does not displace usable MDB timing. Exact header-opening conditions remain deferred.
agreedBellaRule.coherence: Do not mix MDB count with MXF rate, display clock or DF. A header Frame Rate fallback alone does not qualify header Duration or repair isolated MDB timing damage.
agreedBellaRule.originalBin: Leave blank on database-unavailable MXF fallback; no guessed bin name or header search. Preserve separately usable selected-master MDB Original Bin.
agreedBellaRule.presentation: Preserve exact integer/fraction arithmetic, audio sample precision, HH:MM:SS:FF, qualified recorded DF, NDF for genuine applicable absence, blank when required timing unusable, known zero and durations beyond 24 hours.
agreedBellaRule.scope: Other source rules unchanged. Full priorities and MXF concurrency remain later decisions. OldScanner active, Bin Filter unchanged.

supersedesInPart.restriction: Earlier blanket prohibition on all media-header Duration fallback, including when a header was independently read.
supersedesInPart.preserved: Earlier findings, MDB interpretation and display rules remain applicable within their source scope; their source-policy snapshots are historical.

remaining: Verify MXF physical descriptor/track ownership and paired count/rate.
Verify MXF audio display clock and applicable recorded DF association.
Keep explicit MXF rational semantics separate from legacy MDB ExactEditRate conversion.
Review remaining MXF fields and consolidate source priorities at the end.
